description.value: The Honeymoon Bay General Store is a community cornerstone general store nestled on the south shore of Cowichan Lake, stocking groceries, camping supplies, beer/wine/spirits, and a full hot take-out menu including stone-baked pizzas, all-day breakfast, burgers, butter chicken, and samosas. It is also a designated stop on the West Coast Trail Express bus, making it a natural resupply and staging point for cyclists heading to or from the Bamfield trailhead. The store explicitly markets itself as the essential pit stop for hikers, bikers, and campers exploring the Cowichan Lake area.

address.value: 10056 South Shore Rd, Honeymoon Bay, BC V0R 1Y0

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is fully available and confirms the store is an active general store at 10056 South Shore Rd, Honeymoon Bay BC, with phone 250-932-1600. The biking/camping page explicitly stocks propane and calls the store a pit stop for bikers, and the hot food page confirms an extensive take-out menu; no explicit mention of bike parking infrastructure, water refill, washrooms, or a pump. OSM name ('Honeymoon Bay Food & General Store') differs from the website's consistent branding ('Honeymoon Bay General Store'), which is flagged as a concern.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM records the business as 'Honeymoon Bay Food & General Store' but the website consistently uses 'Honeymoon Bay General Store' throughout all pages.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible general store on the Vancouver Crossing Loop route with groceries, hot food, and camping supplies — a clear asset for touring cyclists.
enrichment_extras.notes: West Coast Trail Express bus stops at this location, connecting cyclists/hikers to the Bamfield trailhead. Phone (250-932-1600) and address (10056 South Shore Rd) sourced from website; OSM record had no contact fields populated.

Hot food.detail: Full hot take-out menu: all-day breakfast, burgers, sandwiches, stone-baked pizzas (including vegan/vegetarian), chicken wings, zucchini sticks, butter chicken, samosas, fries, ice cream

Camping fuel.detail: Biking/camping subpage explicitly lists propane as a stocked item: 'Need propane... No Problem, we got your back!'
